summary: Hot Springs County, WY site listed as gone and placed on the Wind River Indian Reservation; no build, staffing or removal history found, and the road over the pass is closed to the public.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. The site is on the Wind River Indian Reservation, and the road over the pass is closed to the general public.

access.note: On the Wind River Indian Reservation. A 2017 Thermopolis Independent Record notice says the old road over the pass is closed to the general public, and that permission was granted to travel it.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Lookout listings spell it Blondy Pass. The 2017 notice spells it Blonde Pass and describes a road over Blonde/Merritt Pass. The notice never mentions a lookout, so its link to this site is not confirmed.

sources.title: Groups planning trek to Blonde Pass

notes_for_editor: Two searches and the cached pages gave no construction, staffing or removal history. Elevation 8311 ft (about 2,532 m) per firelookout.com; the record has none. The record's ownership is 'unknown'; firelookout.com's location line puts the site on the Wind River Indian Reservation, which a human should weigh before filling ownership. The 2017 notice credits two named people with arranging the permission; check before any site visit.
